class.name: DV_Field
class.brief_description: Data object representing a single row and its interaction logic within a DV_DetailPanel.
class.description:
DV_Field stores label/value pairs and defines how they should be rendered and edited. Beyond static display, it supports various [enum ControlType] variants, allowing the field to act as a slider, text input, or dropdown menu.
Fields can be grouped, styled with an [member accent] color, or displayed as progress bars via [member progress_percent].

members.member: Optional accent color used to tint badges, progress bars, or slider fills.
Determines which UI widget is used for this field (e.g., Slider, LineEdit, or Checkbox).
Marks whether the value can be copied to the clipboard from the UI.
Logical group used to cluster fields under a common header in a [DV_DetailPanel].
Stable programmatic identifier for the field.
Human-readable caption displayed on the left side of the row.
The list of options available when [member control_type] is set to [constant TYPE_DROPDOWN].
The maximum value allowed when using [constant TYPE_SLIDER].
The minimum value allowed when using [constant TYPE_SLIDER].
When non-zero, renders the field as a progress bar using this percentage (0-100).
The current data payload. For interactive fields, this is updated automatically when the user interacts with the UI.
Text shown when the pointer rests on this field's row.
Arbitrary data carried with the field and handed back in the panel's signals — an id, a source record, whatever the game needs to act on the row.
Optional icon drawn before the label.

constants.constant: Uses a LineEdit for text entry.
Uses an HSlider with an optional numeric readout.
Uses an OptionButton populated by [member list_values].
Uses a CheckButton for boolean values.
